author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: I am willing to let the live pipeline keep its current lack of formal sign off for now. We can skip adding a strict review gate to the main forecast job if the shadow environment is set up correctly first. My trade is simple: I will not push for a hard stop on the production deployment path until we have a reliable, isolated shadow run. If the shadow hand off is broken, I will not accept a relaxed pipeline. But if the shadow is stable and verified, I will accept the pipeline remaining as loose as it is today. This keeps us moving without freezing the live system while we sort out the supplier contract issues.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up the strict review gate (formal sign-off) in exchange for the establishment of a reliable shadow environment.
